name: clinical-variant-interpretation
description: Classify variants according to ACMG/AMP guidelines (5-tier system: pathogenic, likely pathogenic, variant of uncertain significance, likely benign, benign) using a structured evidence framework. Each evidence criterion (population frequency, computational predictions, functional data, segregation, de novo status) contributes weighted evidence toward pathogenicity or benignity. ClinGen expert panels provide gene-specific rule modifications.
